Google has announced its Google Play Best of 2026 winners for India, naming Adobe Premiere as Best App and Arknights: Endfield as Best Game.
The announcement, published on November 17, covers productivity, entertainment, creative tools and mobile gaming.
Adobe Premiere brings multitrack video editing and speech enhancement to mobile devices.
Wispr Flow received the Best Innovative App award for its voice-to-text experience, including support for Hindi and Hinglish.
Pronto won Best Productivity Partner, while Pocket FM took Best for Entertainment.
FanCode received Best for Sports Fans, and ibis Paint X was recognised for creative expression.
For users moving between devices, Strava won Best Cross-device App.
Pocket Casts received the Best for Watches award.
Arknights: Endfield also won Best Story.
Other India winners include Monument Valley 3 for Best Indie, Pokémon Champions for Best Multiplayer and eFootball for Best Ongoing.
ScarFall 2.0 received the Best Made in India award.
Google’s broader Asia-Pacific announcement highlights its 100-player Mumbai map, which incorporates local trains and city streets.
That recognition gives the awards a local gaming angle alongside international titles.

Readers should check which country’s list they are viewing.
Google’s US announcement names Notability as Best App, rather than India winner Adobe Premiere.
There are differences in gaming categories too: Moonlight Peaks won Best Cross-device Game in the US.
Google publishes market-specific selections, so a winner reported internationally should not automatically be presented as India’s choice.
For Android users looking for something different to try, the India awards provide a starting point across editing, audio entertainment, productivity and gaming.
